```{r}
# load packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(rcompanion)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(psych)
```

```{r}
# load data file "C:\Users\10845\OneDrive\Desktop\ContentAnalysis_Actual Sample_May 11, 2026_07.11.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv("ContentAnalysis_Actual Sample_May 11, 2026_07.11.csv")|> 
  select(-c(1:13),-35) |> # delete unimportant columns
  select(-c(1:4)) |> 
  slice(-1) |> # delete first 2 rows with no information
  rename("Review_ID" = Q4, # rename columns
         "Coder" = Q1,
         "Category" = Q2,
         "Genre" = Q3,
         "Post_Date" = Q6,
         "Played_Hours" = Q5) |> 
  mutate(Coder = 
           dplyr::recode(Coder,
                        "Xinran" = 4,
                        "Qi" = 3,
                        "Helmi" = 2,
                        "Fion" = 1))
```

```{r}
# change empty spaces into NA values
raw_data[raw_data == ""] <- NA
sum(is.na(raw_data))
```

```{r}
# change mis-coded review_ID and Hours_Played
raw_data <- raw_data |>
  mutate(Review_ID = dplyr::recode(Review_ID,
                           "2341660_7" = "3241660_7",
                           " 271590_2" = "271590_2",
                           "3241600_13" = "3241660_13"))|> 
  mutate(Played_Hours = dplyr::recode(Played_Hours,
                           "206-2" = "206.2",
                           "2026-02-02" = "193.6"))
  
raw_data <- raw_data |> 
  mutate(Review_ID = case_when(
    Review_ID == "3241660_26" & Genre == "Adventure" ~ "346110_26",
    TRUE ~ Review_ID))

# change miscoded game category
target_ids <- paste0("413150_", 31:50)
raw_data$Category[
  raw_data$Review_ID %in% target_ids &
  raw_data$Coder == 2 &
  raw_data$Category == "AAA"
] <- "Indie"

raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    Review_ID %in% c("3241660_21", "3241660_27") ~ "Indie", 
    TRUE ~ Category 
  ))
    
raw_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(Category = case_when(
    Review_ID %in% c("3932890_12", "3241660_21", "3241660_76") ~ "Indie", 
    TRUE ~ Category 
  ))
```



```{r}
# remove repeatedly coded data for ICR
# except coded answers from coder 1, the rest is removed.
cleaned_data <- raw_data %>%
filter(
!(grepl("_(10|[1-9])$", Review_ID) & Coder != 1)
)

# change data type for hours played to be numeric
cleaned_data$Played_Hours <- as.numeric(cleaned_data$Played_Hours)

# change question answers to numeric values: "Yes" = 1, "No" = 0
cols <- c(7:17)
cleaned_data[cols] <- lapply(cleaned_data[cols], function(x) {
  ifelse(x == "Yes", 1, 0)
})
cleaned_data = cleaned_data |> 
  slice(-1)
```


```{r}
# separate review ID by game code and review ID
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data |> 
  separate_wider_delim(
  Review_ID, # select column
  delim = "_", # way of separation
  names = c("Game Code", "ID"), too_many = "merge")

cleaned_data <- cleaned_data  |> 
  mutate(ID = str_pad(ID, width = 2, pad = "0"))

# Summary of Game Code and Unique Category
game_summary <- cleaned_data |>
  group_by(`Game Code`) |>
  summarise(
    Total_IDs = n(),
    Unique_Categories = n_distinct(Category) 
  )

# Change miscoded game code
cleaned_data$Genre[cleaned_data$`Game Code` == "646570"] <- "Strategy"
cleaned_data$Genre[cleaned_data$`Game Code` == "413150"] <- "Simulation"
```

```{r}
# Chi-Square for RQ1: Main Dimensions by Game Category

# H1: Aesthetic Dimension
aesthetic_table <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q10)
aesthetic_table
prop.table(aesthetic_table, margin = 1)
h1_chi <- chisq.test(aesthetic_table)
h1_chi
cramerV(aesthetic_table)

# H2: Narrative Dimension
narrative_table <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q13)
narrative_table
prop.table(narrative_table, margin = 1)
h2_chi <- chisq.test(narrative_table)
h2_chi
cramerV(narrative_table)

# H3: Gameplay Dimension
gameplay_table <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q17)
gameplay_table
prop.table(gameplay_table, margin = 1)
h3_chi <- chisq.test(gameplay_table)
h3_chi
cramerV(gameplay_table)
```

```{r}
table_Category_environment

# Q9 - Audio

table_Category_audio

# Narrative Sub-elements
table_Category_plot <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q11)
table_Category_plot
chisq.test(table_Category_plot)
cramerV(table_Category_plot)

table_Category_charBuild <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q12)
table_Category_charBuild
chisq.test(table_Category_charBuild)
cramerV(table_Category_charBuild)

# Gameplay Sub-elements
table_Category_challenge <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q14)
table_Category_challenge
chisq.test(table_Category_challenge)
cramerV(table_Category_challenge)

table_Category_control <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q15)
table_Category_control
chisq.test(table_Category_control)
cramerV(table_Category_control)

table_Category_mechanism <- table(cleaned_data$Category, cleaned_data$Q16)
table_Category_mechanism
chisq.test(table_Category_mechanism)
cramerV(table_Category_mechanism)

mention_plot_data <- cleaned_data |> 
  filter(!is.na(Category)) |> 
  select(Category, Q10, Q13, Q17) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Q10, Q13, Q17),
    names_to = "dimension",
    values_to = "mentioned" ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(mentioned)) |> 
  mutate(
    dimension = case_match(
      dimension,
      "Q10" ~ "Aesthetic",
      "Q13" ~ "Narrative",
      "Q17" ~ "Gameplay"
    ),
    mentioned = as.numeric(as.character(mentioned))) |> 
  group_by(dimension, Category) |> 
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_mentioned = sum(mentioned == 1),
    percent_mentioned = n_mentioned / n_total,
    .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(label = paste0(n_mentioned, "/", n_total, "\n", round(percent_mentioned * 100, 1), "%"))

ggplot(
  mention_plot_data,
  aes(x = dimension, y = percent_mentioned, fill = Category)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "AAA" = "gray",
      "Indie" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Dimension",
    y = "Percentage of reviews mentioning the Dimension",
    fill = "Game Category",
    title = "Mentions of aesthetic, narrative, and gameplay dimensions by Game Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) |> 
theme(
panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
 panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# Spearman's Correlation for RQ4
# skewed data set, method adopts Spearman 
# without removing IQR
result_aesthetics <- cor.test(cleaned_data$Played_Hours, cleaned_data$Q10, method = "spearman")
print(result_aesthetics) 
result_narratives <- cor.test(cleaned_data$Played_Hours, cleaned_data$Q13, method = "spearman")
print(result_narratives) 
result_gameplay <- cor.test(cleaned_data$Played_Hours, cleaned_data$Q17, method = "spearman")
print(result_gameplay) 

# Determine whether to remove the upper and lower limit
# Create the cleaned dataset (The IQR Filter)
Q1 <- quantile(cleaned_data$Played_Hours, .25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3 <- quantile(cleaned_data$Played_Hours, .75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1

lower_limit <- max(0, Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val)
upper_limit <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val

data_cleaned_both <- cleaned_data  |> 
  filter(Played_Hours >= lower_limit & Played_Hours <= upper_limit)

# Run the comparison (using lowercase q and forcing numeric)
comparison <- data.frame(
  Dimension = c("q10", "q13", "q17"),
  
  Original_Mean = c(
    mean(as.numeric(cleaned_data$Q10), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(as.numeric(cleaned_data$Q13), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(as.numeric(cleaned_data$Q17), na.rm = TRUE)),
  
  Cleaned_Mean = c(
    mean(as.numeric(data_cleaned_both$Q10), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(as.numeric(data_cleaned_both$Q13), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(as.numeric(data_cleaned_both$Q17), na.rm = TRUE)))

print(comparison)
# Results do not show a significant difference after removing the outliers 

describe(data_cleaned_both$Played_Hours)

# Even though it solved the problem of skewness, the results of mentioning does not change much.
# Hence, in the final test, we will not remove the outliers in RQ4, keeping N=900
# For better visualization, dividing played_hours into 4 tiers
cleaned_data <- cleaned_data %>%
  mutate(play_tier = ntile(Played_Hours, 4))

group_profile_sum <- cleaned_data %>%
  group_by(play_tier) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Min_Hrs = min(Played_Hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Hrs = max(Played_Hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Calculate % of people who said '1' for each column
    count_q10 = sum(Q10, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_q13 = sum(Q13, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_q17 = sum(Q17, na.rm = TRUE))
print(group_profile_sum)

# RQ 4 Visualization
# Re-create the dataframe 
tier_data_counts <- data.frame(
  tier = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  Label = c("Tier 1\n(0-13.9h)", "Tier 2\n(13.9-59.5h)", "Tier 3\n(59.8-219.9h)", "Tier 4\n(220.4-7292.2h)"),
  # Your absolute raw counts from the summary output
  Aesthetics = c(19, 35, 31, 31),
  Narrative = c(19, 28, 49, 28),
  Gameplay = c(184, 194, 185, 177)
)

tier_long_counts <- tier_data_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Aesthetics, Narrative, Gameplay), 
               names_to = "Dimension", 
               values_to = "Count")


ggplot(tier_long_counts, aes(x = tier, y = Count, group = Dimension, color = Dimension)) +
  # Emphasizes Narrative visually by keeping it thicker than the background baselines
  geom_line(aes(size = Dimension == "Narrative"), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Dimension == "Narrative")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Gameplay" = "Blue",   "Narrative" = "#B22222", "Aesthetics" = "#7FC97F" )) +
  annotate("text",x = 3, y = 170, label = "Gamepley", color = "Blue", size = 4 ) +  
  annotate("text",x = 3.5, y = 60, label = "Narrative", color = "#B22222", size = 4 ) +  
  annotate("text",x = 3, y = 20, label = "Aesthetics", color = "#7FC97F", size = 4 ) +  
  scale_size_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 0.8, "TRUE" = 1.8), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, labels = tier_data_counts$Label) +
  labs(title = "Relationship between Frequency of Dimension Mentioning\n by Player Tier",
       x = "Engagement Tiers",
       y = "Total Number of Reviews (Sum)",
       color = "Dimension") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) 
```
